findings.title: Template variables are interpolated twice in the shard-splitting path
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery() now interpolates every target with datasource.applyTemplateVariables() at the entry point (line 52), and each sharded sub-request is then delegated to runSplitQuery() (line 163), which this PR also changed to call datasource.applyTemplateVariables() on the same targets again (querySplitting.ts line 299). The updated test in shardQuerySplitting.test.ts confirms this: it expects applyTemplateVariables to have been called 5 times for a single-target request (once at entry, once per sub-request). For most variables the second pass is a no-op because the variable text is already gone, but if a variable's interpolated value itself contains a $-prefixed pattern (e.g. a textbox/custom variable whose value contains '$__' or another variable name, or a label value with a literal '$var' string), the second interpolation will rewrite it, corrupting the query sent to Loki. Consider skipping re-interpolation for targets that have already been interpolated (e.g. a flag on the sub-request or an option to runSplitQuery) so interpolation happens exactly once.
